note: Free camping area beside the Fort Buford State Historic Site (State Historical Society of North Dakota), near the Missouri-Yellowstone confluence: no numbered sites; campers park on any level spot under the shade trees or in the open, with picnic tables, fire rings and trash cans. Check in at the Missouri-Yellowstone Confluence Interpretive Center. The free rate is camper-reported (June-September 2026); the Society's page names the campground but posts no camping fee. --Claude
summary: Run by the State Historical Society of ND (not ND Parks): no booking system, not on reserveNDparks; the site page lists 'Picnic area and campgrounds' and 'Modern facilities on site' and nothing else about camping (no fee, season, site count). Camper reports 2026: free, check in at the Confluence center, no numbered sites, any size rig, 'No water or dump'. Derived fields left; note cleaned of repeated fields. Pin by the entrance; not waterfront stands.
